The '''Mygeeto theater''' was one of the six theaters of operations of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], which took place during the final stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Astrography==
The Mygeeto theater was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], in a region known as the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]]. This field of operations was named after the key [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==History==
[[File:Battle_of_Mygeeto.jpg|thumb|left|225px|[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and his [[Galactic Marines/Legends|troops]] in action on [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]]]
In the Mygeeto theater, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] [[Battle of the Ywllandr system|broke]] the Separatist defenses at the [[Ywllandr system/Legends|Ywllandr system]], clearing the way to the key [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] world of Mygeeto.<ref name="TEGtW" /> Consequently, Jedi General [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] led the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]] in an [[Battle of Mygeeto|assault]] against the IGBC [[Fortress/Legends|citadels]] of Mygeeto.<ref name="TEA" />
